steps.title: Grow yeast culture and harvest
steps.instruction: Culture Saccharomyces cerevisiae expressing Rpb3‑Flag (Δprb1 strain) in 10 L YPD medium and harvest cells when OD600 reaches 5–10.

steps.title: Freeze cell pellet and grind
steps.instruction: Resuspend the harvested pellet in 1/10 of its volume with lysis buffer, dispense drop‑by‑drop into liquid nitrogen to form frozen droplets, then grind the frozen powder using a SPEX 6875D Freezer/Mill at 15 cycles s⁻¹ for 6 cycles (2 min grinding, 2 min cooling each). Store the resulting powder at –80 °C if needed.

steps.title: Extract lysate by ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the frozen powder in an equal volume of cold lysis buffer, centrifuge for 1 h at 4 °C, 40 000 rpm in a 45 Ti rotor, and collect the supernatant. Perform all steps at 4 °C.

steps.title: Flag affinity purification
steps.instruction: Purify RNAPII by Flag affinity chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Load supernatant onto Flag resin (Sigma A2220) packed column (Bio‑Rad 7321010) using ~3 mL dry‑bead volume per 100–200 mL extract.
Wash column with 30 mL wash buffer 1, then with 30 mL wash buffer 2.
Add 3 mL elution buffer, mix with a pipette, cap the column and incubate with rotation for 15 min.
Collect eluate; repeat the elution step four more times and pool all fractions (≈15 mL total Flag eluate).

steps.title: MonoQ ion exchange purification
steps.instruction: Further purify Flag‑eluted RNAPII on a Mono Q column.

substeps.instruction: Load the Flag eluate onto a 1 mL Mono Q 5/50 GL column (Cytiva 17‑5166‑01) using an ÄKTA Pure system.
Elute protein with a potassium acetate gradient between Buffer A and Buffer B at 0.5–1 mL min⁻¹ over 10 mL, collecting 0.5 mL fractions.
Analyze fractions by SDS‑PAGE (load precipitates as well).

steps.title: Pool, concentrate, and buffer‑exchange RNAPII
steps.instruction: Combine RNAPII‑containing fractions and exchange into MonoQ Buffer A using Vivaspin 20 concentrators (MWCO 100 kDa). Add Buffer A to the pooled eluate (1–2 mL) to a total volume of ~15 mL, concentrate to 1–2 mL, dilute back to 15 mL, and repeat the concentration/dilution cycle three times. Final protein concentration should be ~0.5 mg mL⁻¹ (1 µM), total amount ≈1 mg.

steps.title: Add glycerol and aliquot
steps.instruction: Add glycerol to a final concentration of 5 %, aliquot 20 µL portions, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Design DNA oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Design long DNA oligos for the elongation complex: the template strand’s 5′ end carries a phosphor modification for ligation; the non‑template strand’s 5′ end carries a biotin for streptavidin Dynabead attachment; include a BamHI site at the RNAPII binding region (protected from BamHI digestion when the EC is correctly assembled).

steps.title: Prepare and run PAGE for oligos
steps.instruction: Dissolve lyophilized oligos (IDT, desalt) in water to 300 µM. Mix 30 µL of this solution with 1/10 volume 50 % glycerol, load samples onto a 10 % polyacrylamide gel (7.2 × 8.6 cm, 10‑well comb) alongside a separate well containing bromophenol blue dye (0.25 % bromophenol blue, 5 % glycerol). Run the gel at ~100 V in TBE until the dye reaches the bottom. (PAGE‑purified oligos can also be purchased directly.)

steps.title: Extract DNA bands from gel
steps.instruction: Visualize the gel (without nucleic‑acid dye) under epi‑blue light for 10 s (Azure system) or by UV shadowing; print the image, increase contrast if needed, and cut out the oligo bands. Transfer gel pieces to a 1.5 mL tube, add 300 µL TE buffer, freeze 10 min at –80 °C, thaw at 50 °C, incubate 20 min at 50 °C; repeat the freeze‑thaw cycle, spin briefly, and transfer 240 µL supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitate oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Add 14 µL 5 M NaCl then 750 µL 100 % ethanol to the supernatant, mix thoroughly, and spin at 18 000 g, 4 °C for 30 min (immediate spin recovers >85 % of oligo; overnight at –20 °C can increase yield). Discard supernatant, wash pellet with 800 µL 70 % ethanol, spin 10 min at 18 000 g, 4 °C, discard. Spin again 1 min at 18 000 g, 4 °C, discard remaining liquid, air‑dry the pellet with the lid open for 10 min at room temperature, and resuspend in 50 µL water.

steps.title: Quantify and dilute DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and dilute the oligonucleotides to 10 µM with water.
